description: Close the named app, or close the active session app when app is omitted. If the session booted a local simulator or emulator, add shutdown when you finish, unless the user asks to keep it running; close alone never stops the device. Android ADB close fails with android-app-close-timeout if the app stays foreground past 2s, a killed process does not exit within 10s, or a new process runs past 2s. It fails with android-process-probe-unavailable when adb pidof cannot list the app processes; if that happens before the force-stop, the app keeps running. If close cannot confirm its cleanup on a session that holds a device claim, the session and its claim stay; run close again with the same options to retry the cleanup, leaving out save-script once the script is published. Times out after 90s.

device.description: Device name; ids go in udid or serial.

force.description: Overwrite an existing --save-script target instead of refusing (alias: --overwrite).

includeCost.description: Add agent cost (cost.wallClockMs, …) to the result, returned as JSON text.

mcpOutputFormat.description: Result text: compact optimized (default) or the full result as JSON (larger).

responseLevel.description: Result detail: digest (smallest) or full (largest), as JSON; default is compact text.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial.

name: close
